entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this helmet I bought. It's ridiculous. I want my money back now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference? The color is completely wrong! It looked bright red on your website, but it's more like a dull maroon. I'm not wearing this. It's been sitting in the box unopened since it arrived. I want to return it, and I don't want to hear any excuses.

I understand your frustration with the color not meeting your expectations. Getting the right gear is important, especially when it comes to your safety and comfort. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get your order number?
It's VF-8675309. Look, I've had it for about two weeks. If you tell me I can't return it, I want to speak to your manager immediately, and you can expect a very detailed review online.

Thank you for that, one moment. Okay, I see your order. You received the helmet 14 days ago. Since the box is unopened and you're well within our 90-day return window, I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh. Well... good. That's what I thought. Finally, some simple customer service. So what's the next step?

I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. You just need to print it, attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Does that work for you?
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
